# MarchJS
> Tiny fine-grained reactive TypeScript framework: components run once, signals bind directly to DOM nodes, no virtual DOM, zero runtime dependencies, JSX compiled by an esbuild plugin, CSP/Trusted Types safe.

- [AI instructions](AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md): concepts, syntax, data, actions, schema/forms/tables, routing, do/don't, mistakes
- [README](README.md): overview, language table, modules
- [Core](docs/core.md): signals, store, h(), control flow, pipes, i18n
- [SEO](docs/seo.md): route head, useHead, Open Graph/Twitter, JSON-LD, prerender + hydrate, sitemap/robots, march seo check
- [UI](docs/ui.md), [Forms](docs/forms.md), [Table](docs/table.md), [Charts](docs/charts.md), [Icons](docs/icons.md): the March set, open-source icon packs, march icons
- [Examples](examples/): counter, form, crud, router, async, table, charts
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [TypeScript](docs/core.md#typescript)
- [Showcase](examples/showcase/App.tsx)
